question: acp-facade-cladding-install
unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (Auckland, NZD, GST-exclusive, openings deducted)

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (Auckland, NZD, GST-exclusive, openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of the seven distinct components above, each priced once: QV ACP cassette system 560-780/m2 + QV-based 3mm PVDF flashings 73.9-109.4/m2 + QV EWP hire 17.8-24.9/m2 + four minor allowances 23.8-44.2/m2 = 675.5-958.5/m2, rounded to 675-960/m2. Totals for the 450 m2 nominal quantity: low $303,750, high $431,550, mid c.$367,650 (450 x 817). Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, air barrier, window sealing, substrate repair, cavity fire stopping, windows/doors/roofing, structural steel, scaffold, edge protection, traffic management and PS1/PS3 producer statements, per the fixed scope. Confidence low: the dominant component rests on one unreviewed QV row published as a 2:1 range whose inclusion of the carrier/subgirt is not stated, and the flashings rate is an adjusted proxy for a 3mm gauge the QV library does not carry. Allowances carry only c.4% of the band.

band.unit: NZD per m2 of net cladding face area (window and door openings deducted), GST exclusive, Auckland
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no double counting: 421-458 (QV ACP cassette system, AKL Alupanel straight panels) + 80-100 (QV top-hat subgirt proxy) + 8-20 (thermally broken bracket allowance) + 56.4-76.9 (168 lm 3mm folded flashings, QV 0.95x500 girth row x1.75-2.4) + 26.5-32.0 (60 lm parapet capping, QV 0.9x750 stepped row x1.50-1.80) + 9.1-13.7 (38 lm corners, QV 1.4mm box corner x2.0-3.0) + 19.1-20.5 (QV articulated diesel boom 267/day x 30 days + transport, /450 m2) + 3-7 + 4-10 + 3-8 (allowances for opening cut-outs, joint baffles, film removal/clean/waste) = 630-746/m2. Total for the 450 m2 nominal quantity = $283,500-$335,700. Largest component (the panel system) rests on a cited QV row, so the band is established. Confidence lowered to LOW because (a) QV's ACP system rows do not itemise inclusions, so if the subgirt/carrier layer is already in the Alupanel rate the band falls to ~$530-646/m2, and (b) 266 lm of 3mm flashings (~17% of the band) is priced by a stated gauge adjustment on a 0.95mm row rather than a published 3mm rate. Allowances carry 3-8% of the band. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, air barrier/wrap/window sealing, substrate repair, cavity fire stopping and C-clause verification, windows/doors/louvres/soffits/balustrades/roofing, structural steel or framing strengthening, perimeter scaffold/edge protection/traffic management/footpath cover, and PS1/PS3/weathertightness/facade-engineer producer statements, per the fixed scope.

band.unit: NZD per m2 of net cladding face area, Auckland, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of the six components above, each already expressed per m2 of the 450 m2 net face: ACP proprietary system 458-920 (QV row t1:r7; Alupanel rows 421-458 bracket the low end) + 266 lm of 3mm folded aluminium flashings 102-150 (QV row t21:r26 proxied up for gauge, cross-checked against QV 3mm aluminium sheet at 453/m2) + 30 shifts of 15m diesel articulated boom 17.8 (QV row t8:r15) + delivery/pickup, waste and shop-drawing allowances 8.6-19.8. Low end 587 x 450 m2 = $264,000; high end 1,107 x 450 m2 = $498,000. Allowances are under 4% of the total, so the band rests on the cited QV rows. Confidence LOW: the proprietary panel row's inclusions are not itemised and its published range spans 2x, and the 3mm flashing rate is a stated gauge-uplifted proxy with no published 3mm folded row. The 40mm cavity framing (QV top hat to steel girts at 600 crs, AKL 87/m2, row 9bd8f998...:t12:r23) is deliberately NOT added to avoid double counting against the panel system rate; add it if the adopted system prices panels only, roughly +8%.

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (window and door openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of cited QV components, Auckland centre, NZD GST exclusive: panel system 421-550 + subgirt/cavity 87-120 + reveal/head/sill flashings 30.0-37.2 + base closure 11.5-14.1 + parapet capping 22.0-27.3 + corners 3.4-5.5 + boom lift access 17.8 + minor-item allowance 8-20 = 601-792/m2. For the nominal 450 m2 net face: LOW 601 x 450 = $270,450; HIGH 792 x 450 = $356,400; mid-point ~$697/m2 = $313,650. Every figure is either a cited QV CostBuilder row (unreviewed) with a stated adjustment, or a labelled allowance; nothing is presented as a published rate. Allowances carry only 1-3% of the total, so the band does not lean on them. Confidence is LOW because: (1) the key ACP row does not state core, coating, cassette fabrication or whether the carrier is included, and its sibling Reynobond row spans 458-920/m2; (2) the FR-mineral-core/PVDF premium is a stated adjustment, not a published rate; (3) the subgirt rate is galvanised steel top-hat, not aluminium top-hat on thermally broken brackets, and overlaps the panel rate if the panel rate already carries a carrier; (4) 3mm flashings and the parapet capping are priced from 0.95mm straight-flashing rows; (5) access is priced at a QV day rate because QV publishes no weekly hire rate. Confirm the cassette system, carrier/subgirt bracket grid, FR-core sheet price and flashings scope with the proprietary system supplier and a specialist facade fabricator (NZ distributors of Alucobond, Alpolic or Vitrabond, and rainscreen cassette fabricators), and confirm the 6-week lift rate with an access hire company.

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (window and door openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of the priced components and allowances, each in per-m2 terms over 450 m2 net face area. Low = panel $458/m2 (QV row ...t1:r7 low) + flashings 266 lm at $130/lm = $76.84/m2 + boom 30 days at $267 = $17.80/m2 + mobilisation $700/450 = $1.56/m2 + sundries $10/m2 = $564.20/m2, i.e. $253,890 for 450 m2. High = panel $920/m2 + flashings 266 lm at $200/lm = $118.22/m2 + boom $17.80/m2 + mobilisation $1,200/450 = $2.67/m2 + sundries $25/m2 = $1,083.69/m2, i.e. $487,660 for 450 m2. Mid $760/m2 (the most probable point for a plain solid-colour, single-colour 4mm PVDF job, because the top of QV's Reynebond band reflects premium/metallic finishes and greater panel thicknesses not in this scope) = $342,000 for the 450 m2. Excluded per brief: GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, rigid air barrier, sealing to windows, substrate repair, cavity fire barriers and fire-stopping, C-clause verification, windows/doors/louvres/soffits/balustrades/roofing, structural steel and strengthening, perimeter scaffold and edge protection, traffic management and footpath cover, and all PS1/PS3/weathertightness/facade-engineer producer statements. CONFIDENCE LOW: the dominant component (roughly 80% of the band) rests on a single unreviewed QV row whose inclusions are not itemised, with a published spread of $462/m2 (458 to 920); the reserve for the unconfirmed subgirt/carrier/bracket/cavity element is carried as a caveat sensitivity (+$155–215/m2) rather than added. If that element is confirmed as excluded from the QV panel rate, the band shifts to roughly $720–1,300/m2.
